description: Inspect the authenticated Fabric identity or list peer hosts.
name: fabric_context

description: Send and read mail with explicit cursors.
name: fabric_mail

description: Create and manage fenced project tasks.
name: fabric_task

description: Read the activity journal or append a note.
name: fabric_events

description: Manage advisory work claims and landing leases.
name: fabric_lease

description: Submit and wait for results, list, inspect, wait for, cancel or resume runs. List returns compact attempts newest first; pass next_after as after to continue. Set detail for full records.
name: fabric_run

description: Run, inspect, cancel or resume a checkpointed graph. Run and resume take a project-local document path.
name: fabric_graph

description: Read bounded output or fetch a manifest artefact.
name: fabric_output

description: Discover inbox, console, chair, graph, task, lease and event tools. Call discovered tools by name.
name: fabric_discover

description: Post human requests, list, answer, close or acknowledge; route to an owner host when needed. Steer a lane or message a chair session, both local-only and refused when unsupported.
name: fabric_inbox

description: Read projects, sessions, board, tree, overview and attempt detail. Search is local only, returns the first match per artifact and rescans on each cursor page; board and tree can include peers.
name: fabric_console

description: Read and update chair summaries and append or list chair logs.
name: fabric_chair
